This is what my neighbors said when I wanted to get a job. Now, I speak fluent English within a month and their kids come to me for tuition. I did this using the 'English Seekho' app, which gave me an AI coach to practice speaking and correct my mistakes. While neighbors watched TV serials, I practiced and learned. Download the app to earn respect in your neighborhood too.] Speaker B: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
